name: scenario_a_sunrise
title: Sunrise over the swamps and canyons
about: Starts on the rising sun with parrots flying close past the lens and a far flock crossing the sun's disc, then swings down onto the battle in the swamp between the east canyon and the plank bridge as the first shots fall; from the bottom-left road blue reinforcements come in (an MLRS firing its salvos, a heavy tank, three squads) while two red mechs come down the road from the red fort; from 12 s a side shot from the east tracks the blue force crossing the plank bridge (squads in file, the jeep, the heavy tank; more squads wading beside it) and rises as the lead reaches the far bank and the red mechs; a crocodile swims the stream; the radar's zone is blue; all from RTS heights.

about_v4: Starts on the rising sun with parrots flying close past the lens and a far flock crossing the sun's disc, then swings down onto the battle in the swamp between the east canyon and the plank bridge as the first shots fall (squads wading, a tank on the bridge, the jeep driving in on the road behind it); from the bottom-left road blue reinforcements come in (an MLRS firing its salvos, a heavy tank, three squads) while two red mechs come down the road from the red fort; a crocodile swims the stream between the lines; the radar's zone is already blue; all from RTS heights; the red fort in the background at the end.
